notablePrerequisites: All modes but "Abandon Ship" and one other have been chosen for Kobayashi Maru Scenario.
easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls a nonland permanent with an equal or lesser mana value than Kobayashi Maru Scenario.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Puca's Mischief and Kobayashi Maru Scenario both trigger.
Choose the last mode other than "Abandon Ship" for Kobayashi Maru scenario.
Resolve the Puca's Mischief trigger, exchanging control of a nonland permanent an opponent controls with equal or lesser mana value and Kobayashi Maru Scenario.
At the beginning of that opponent's upkeep, they are forced to choose the "Abandon Ship" mode and lose the game.
